authoredNote: Lines computed from `nl -ba` of the committed fixture; the positive rows pin BOTH metadata.owner and metadata.ownerEvidence, and the negative row pins the ABSENT case (`meta.owner: null`) so an over-claim fails just as loudly as a miss.
rationale: PINS THE CLASS-STATIC CLASS: a call whose receiver root names a CLASS declared in this file carries that class as owner (evidence `class-static`) ONLY when the class body declares the member — `Widget.create()` pins the positive. The negative row is `Other.notDeclared()`: the class is declared but does NOT declare the member, so the row must carry NO owner (`meta.owner: null`). That pair is the difference between reading the class and guessing it.
